problem: A test is 99% sensitive and 80% specific. The condition has 1% prevalence. A random person tests positive. What is the probability they have the condition?

reasoning_trace.text: So a positive result means a 99% chance of the condition.
reasoning_trace.label: invalid

verification.details: Reports P(+|D) instead of P(D|+) and neglects the base rate; the correct posterior is 0.048.

notes: paired positive: prb-001000. Fallacy: base-rate neglect / inverted conditional.
